claim: The sample opens a populated assessment, resets, exports JSON, and does not change real exam data.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser page; real-data marker keys preloaded; enter from the landing action; assert no API writes and unchanged markers

claim: Each new exam creates separate candidate and assessor capability links.
sandbox: isolated claims SQLite database; create one exam; open both tokens and assert distinct roles plus wrong-token rejection

claim: The candidate sees the scored rubric before starting.
sandbox: isolated exam reached after the demo entry point; candidate view before submission start

claim: The assessor cannot score before candidate submission, and submitted evidence can no longer change.
sandbox: isolated active submission; direct premature assessment is rejected and candidate evidence remains writable

claim: The assessor receives the work log the candidate submits.
sandbox: isolated submission with a unique work-log value; assessor API must return the exact value

claim: The assessor receives only command excerpts the candidate enters.
sandbox: isolated submission with two entered command lines; assessor API must return exactly those lines

claim: A checkpoint records the SHA-256 hash of candidate-chosen content.
sandbox: isolated submission; compare returned checkpoint hash with an independent SHA-256 calculation

claim: A candidate can upload one artifact up to 15 MB, and a later upload replaces it.
sandbox: isolated submission; accept exact 15 MB, replace with a second file, download exact replacement bytes, reject 15 MB plus one byte

claim: The exported JSON record includes the task, submitted evidence, rubric scores, feedback, and decision.
sandbox: isolated assessed submission; parse downloaded response and compare its task, evidence, scores, feedback, and decision

claim: Submission text and artifact bytes are AES-256-GCM encrypted before SQLite storage.
sandbox: isolated claims SQLite database; save unique text and artifact sentinels, confirm neither appears in database files, then retrieve decrypted text

claim: The database stores SHA-256 hashes of role tokens instead of raw tokens.
sandbox: isolated claims SQLite database; create an exam, assert raw tokens are absent and independently calculated token hash is present

claim: Expired submissions are purged before a read, and an assessor can delete them sooner.
where: privacy, candidate and assessor workspaces, README
sandbox: isolated early deletion followed by a 404; then an in-memory boundary test expires a live record and asserts empty assessor output plus physical deletion

claim: The timebox is informational and does not lock candidate writing when time ends.
sandbox: open demo, then run the isolated in-memory backend boundary test with an ended timebox and assert evidence remains writable

claim: Typed candidate drafts remain available in that browser while it is offline.
where: landing facts, candidate workspace, privacy, README
sandbox: dedicated browser context; isolated candidate submission; set context offline, type work, assert field and namespaced local draft remain, then close only that context

claim: The app does not request webcam or microphone access.
where: landing privacy boundary, candidate workspace, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh demo page with media APIs instrumented; exercise sample review and assert zero media calls

claim: The app does not lock the browser, use fullscreen, or request pointer lock.
sandbox: fresh demo page with fullscreen and pointer-lock APIs instrumented; navigate to create and back; assert zero lock calls

claim: Candidate entry does not request a biometric or platform credential.
sandbox: fresh candidate page with credential API instrumented; enter an alias and assert zero credential requests

claim: Rubric scores are entered by the assessor, not generated by an AI cheating detector.
sandbox: fresh demo; edit a rubric score and assert the value changes with no model or OpenAI request

claim: Using the sample sends requests only to the product origin and sets no product cookie.
sandbox: dedicated clean browser context; record every sample request, cookie, and sendBeacon call

claim: Exam creation, submission, assessment, export, and deletion controls require no account or provider tools.
where: landing pricing, create page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser; complete create, candidate submit, assessor score, and JSON download while recording external requests

claim: A cached valid provider license saves and reloads the last exam template on that device.
sandbox: fresh browser with a recorded valid daily license verdict; create an exam, return to the form, load the saved template, and compare its title

claim: A cached valid provider license adds a provider name to new exams.
sandbox: fresh browser with a recorded valid daily license verdict; create a branded exam and assert the candidate view shows the provider name

claim: An incoming or pasted valid Sociobot license enables provider tools on that device.
sandbox: fresh browser with the Sociobot verification endpoint fulfilled by a recorded valid response; assert query cleanup, namespaced storage, verification tokens, and provider control

claim: The built service starts with only PORT and reuses its generated encryption key.
sandbox: open demo, then run the runtime contract in a temporary directory with an empty process environment except PORT

claim: New provider purchases are unavailable, so the app does not present a broken checkout action.
where: landing pricing, create page, privacy, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser; assert the unavailable state, no checkout link, and no checkout request during the sample entry
